title: MoreApplesPlus
description: This Mod Adds 4 new Golden Apple variants(Copper, iron, Diamond and Netherite) Aswell as 4 Apple juices of the same typing.
body:
Adds 4 New Golden Apple Types Being Copper, Iron, Diamond And Netherite.
Adds 5 New Apple Juices For Each Type Of Apple(Exluding Normal Golden Apple) And Is Crafted By Brewing An Apple And Empty Bottles

Copper Apples Give A Small Amount Of Regen
Copper Apples Are Crafted With 1 Apple And 8 Copper blocks
Copper Apple Juice Gives Some Speed


Iron Apple Give Some Regen And Some Absorption
Iron Apples Are Crafted With 1 Apple And 8 Iron Ingots
Iron Apple Juice Gives Speed And Some Regen

Diamond Apples Give Good Regen, Great Absorption And Some Strength
Diamond Apples are Crafted With 1 Apple And 8 Diamonds
Diamond Apple Juice Gives Speed Regen And Some Absorption

Netherite Apples Give Great Regen, Great Absorption, Good Strength And Fire Resistance
Netherite Apples Are Crafted With 1 Diamond Apple and 1 Ancient Debris
Netherite Apple Juice Gives Speed, Regen, Absorption, Haste And Fire Res

More Coming Soon
